fitReason: Recent Tufts AP move with strong algorithmic HRI, goal inference and social-navigation fit. Her independent GOLD agenda is relevant to CS-centered assistive robotics; the executed current learned-robot anchor is collaborative.

physicalEvidence.summary: HumAIN distills a privileged multimodal teacher into a vision-and-goal student that predicts robot paths. The full July 2026 paper separately reports real Clearpath Jackal navigation around approaching/crossing people. Mirsky is a current Tufts coauthor, but direct experimental contribution and Tufts apparatus ownership are unspecified; use collaborative physical 20. The authors explicitly caution that the system is not robust for unconstrained open-world operation.
